title: Schneider iEM3255 Energy Meter
description: Baseline model for the Schneider iEM3255 three-phase CT-connected energy meter with Modbus RTU, multi-tariff, digital input and output, MID/MIR (ordering reference A9MEM3255), read over RS-485 Modbus RTU. Register map: iEM3100/iEM3200/iEM3300 series user guide DOCA0005EN-16, Communications using Modbus, Modbus register list, PDF pages 62-69 (PDF page numbers equal the printed ones); only rows that apply to the iEM3255 are used: rows noted 'not applicable for iEM3150/iEM3250/iEM3350' do apply, and rows for other models (the neutral current, iEM3555 only) are left out. The document gives each register as a hexadecimal address and as a register number equal to the address plus 1 (PDF page 56); the model uses the address column, so register 3000 is address 0x0BB7 (2999). Registers are read with function code 03 (PDF page 56). Float32 values take two registers and 64-bit values four; the guide does not state the word order, and no meter was read on hardware: the model reads the high word first, the Modbus default, and the first reading on a real meter must confirm it. Energy is exposed in the 64-bit integer format (Wh, varh); the guide calls it signed 64-bit integer in its introduction and lists a type table that describes Int64 with an unsigned range, so the model reads it as signed, which gives the same values for any energy below 2^63. The 32-bit float copies of the same energy values (addresses 0xB02B onward) are left out. The firmware version word is in the manufacturer's DLF format, which the model leaves raw. Left out: configuration (power system, ratios, nominal values, pulse and tariff settings, communication settings, date and time), the command interface, the reset dates, serial number, hardware revision, manufacturer and meter name strings, the digital input status bitmap (two registers with only bit 1 used, the register holding it is not stated), the phase reactive energy and phase name registers for the 1PH4W multi-line wiring, and the neutral current of the iEM3555.
